R0260.title: Heavy-Goods Splitting for Pickup Fee
R0260.definition: Couriers split heavy-goods orders into multiple small parcels at entry to fraudulently claim pickup fees and billing differentials.
R0260.description:
Heavy-goods splitting for pickup fee occurs when couriers or sites split one heavy-goods order into multiple small parcels in the system, exploiting per-piece pickup-fee rules versus heavy-goods billing to claim extra gains.

The risk causes multiplied pickup-fee expenditure and distorts heavy-goods billing and capacity data. Detection must combine order-parcel-weight linkage, heavy-goods splitting monitoring, and targeted inspection for billing reconciliation.
R0260.influence: Heavy-goods splitting causes multiplied pickup-fee expenditure and billing-differential losses, distorting heavy-goods billing and capacity data.

observables: Heavy-cargo orders are split into multiple small parcels with distorted chargeable weight
Order-parcel-weight correlations for the same shipment show anomalous splits
Heavy-cargo split-order monitoring shows anomalously high pickup-delivery fee payouts
Couriers or stations concentrate on splitting heavy cargo into small parcels
Chargeable weight shows a systematic gap versus actual goods weight
